scientific_integrity: The full mathematical argument is analytic; numerical code is supplementary and does not prove universal statements. Novelty assessed relative to inspected materials, not independently certified.
scientific_limitations: Finite unions of pairwise disjoint fixed Euclidean balls in dimension at least two, real continuous frequency radius and normalized spherical measure; no connected-domain or overlapping-ball extension. Earlier equivalent diffraction literature is possible.
title: Arithmetic lower floors for the spherical Fourier energy of disjoint balls
